item.title: Help Clean the Ocean You Love
item.description: The ocean provides 50% of our oxygen, but a trash patch 2x the size of Texas is killing it. Ghost nets drown whales daily. Join Marin Green Drinks with Mary Crowley on Feb 10 to see real solutions. Save the seas! Visit our website to RSVP. Event Date: Tuesday, February 10, 2026 - 5:30pm Event Location: 812 4th St. San Rafael Event Contact: maringreendrinks@gmail.com

item.title: Marinship: What it Was
item.description: Marinship - What it Was CMCM's latest exhibit, "Marinship," tells the amazing story of how a shipyard was hastily built in Sausalito during WWII. During it's three short years of operation, the yard produced 15 Liberty Ships and 78 Tankers. Speed, quality, and efficiency was the theme at Marinship during its entire time of operation.
